ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The larger screen is appealing, but I am not currently looking for a tablet.

ItemID: NA; Title: Syntech USB C to USB Adapter Pack of 2 USB C Male to USB3 Female Adapter Compatible with MacBook Pro 2021 iMac iPad Mini 6/Pro MacBook Air 2022 and Other Type C or Thunderbolt 4/3 Devices Midnight; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Adapters could help with my USB peripherals, but I would check whether my current computer needs them before buying.
